minimumEditorApiCheck.scope: C# compilation against installed Unity assemblies; no editor execution or package import

limits: Default MiniJson traversal: 64 container levels and 1,000,000 values. HTTP serialization uses the existing 16 MiB hard output limit and 8 MiB soft warning.
Execution-result normalization retains depth-four / 1,000 items per container and adds 100,000 values across the result.
Output/traversal limits do not cap original objects, total editor memory, intermediate allocations or arbitrary custom getters, iterators and ToString methods.
No Node HTTP download bound is claimed for old/other plugins; incoming JSON parser work remains separate.
Early HTTP size is explicitly a lower bound. Failed output is not evidence that a write did not execute.
Actual Unity 2021 runtime checks remain deferred by maintainer direction. Other operating systems and all optional-package result shapes remain unverified.
